fichas.title: Corridors and corridor access
fichas.summary: Corridors connect rooms and should be generous, spatially varied, and preferably partially open to living areas with natural lighting. Required widths depend on door arrangement, opening direction, and traffic volume. The page illustrates corridor layouts connecting rooms and service spaces, with examples of corridor area and room arrangements.
uses: Provide circulation and access between rooms
Allow people to pass through the corridor
Organize access to bedrooms, cupboards, and other rooms
